name: opendesign-craft
description: OpenDesign craft rulebooks as skills: typography, color, motion and state coverage.

upstreams.name: open-design
upstreams.licence: Apache-2.0; parts adapted from refero_skill, MIT

skills.name: typography
skills.description: Type rules to apply once the faces are chosen: scale steps, line height, letter-spacing (ALL CAPS needs 0.06-0.1em), measure, the three-weight system, and how hierarchy is built (one dominant entry point, rhythm between levels, spacing as hierarchy). Use when setting or checking type in a mockup, prototype or DESIGN.md.

skills.name: color
skills.description: Rules for using a palette: neutral, accent and semantic shares, at most two visible accent uses per screen, WCAG contrast minimums, dark-theme values, tokens named by purpose. Use when applying or checking color in a mockup, prototype or DESIGN.md.

skills.name: motion
skills.description: When motion earns its place and the numbers that bound it: durations, curve versus spring, reduced motion, flashing and looping limits, platform differences. Use before adding, specifying or changing any animation or transition.

skills.name: state-coverage
skills.description: The five states every data surface must render (loading, empty, error, populated, edge), plus form states, empty and error composition, loading thresholds and focus and ARIA rules. Use when designing, building or reviewing any list, table, form, panel or screen that loads or accepts data.
